headline: Brief v2.0.8-beta — Claude 4-State #d9693f Animations, OpenAI Side Moon, 4–5 Step Retry Checklist & 150f Vision
bullets: Claude 4-State Orange (#d9693f) Live Animations: Spinning & breathing starburst petals when starting & checking, 3D orbiting dots while thinking/fathoming/choosing/working, 3-dot wave bounce exclusively when creating files, and 3-dot shrink/expand pulse when finding files or validating.
OpenAI Side Moon + Gemini & OpenRouter Shimmer: Animated crescent moon placed inline beside status words for OpenAI, plus sweeping bright-shiny & gray word shimmer for Gemini and OpenRouter.
4–5 Idea Steps Plan & Auto-Retry Checklist: Displays total planned steps up front, marks finished steps with ✓, and marks failed steps with ✕ while automatically inserting +1 extra retry step.

Clean Phone UI, PC-Matched Animated Cursor & Global Auto-Updater: Edge-to-edge phone layout, proportional Phone -> Tablet -> PC cursor + live typing pill, 150-Frame Live Vision, zero Stop self-clicks, and 1-click updates on Windows, Linux, Samsung & Honor MagicOS.
